# Fetch all songs from song library
song_lib_ids = set()
page_index = 0
page_limit = 20
while True:
    page = apis.spotify.show_song_library(access_token=spotify_token, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
    print('song_lib_page', page_index, 'count', len(page) if page else 0)
    if not page:
        break
    for it in page:
        song_lib_ids.add(it['song_id'])
    page_index += 1
print('song_lib_total_song_ids', len(song_lib_ids))

# Fetch all albums from album library and collect their song_ids
album_lib_song_ids = set()
page_index = 0
while True:
    page = apis.spotify.show_album_library(access_token=spotify_token, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
    print('album_lib_page', page_index, 'count', len(page) if page else 0)
    if not page:
        break
    for alb in page:
        for sid in alb.get('song_ids', []):
            album_lib_song_ids.add(sid)
    page_index += 1
print('album_lib_total_song_ids', len(album_lib_song_ids))

# Fetch all playlists from playlist library and collect their song_ids
playlist_lib_song_ids = set()
page_index = 0
while True:
    page = apis.spotify.show_playlist_library(access_token=spotify_token, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
    print('playlist_lib_page', page_index, 'count', len(page) if page else 0)
    if not page:
        break
    for pl in page:
        for sid in pl.get('song_ids', []):
            playlist_lib_song_ids.add(sid)
    page_index += 1
print('playlist_lib_total_song_ids', len(playlist_lib_song_ids))

# Union and target intersection with liked songs
union_source_song_ids = song_lib_ids | album_lib_song_ids | playlist_lib_song_ids
print('union_source_total_song_ids', len(union_source_song_ids))

liked_and_in_libraries_ids = liked_song_ids & union_source_song_ids
print('target_total_liked_in_libraries', len(liked_and_in_libraries_ids))

# Print a small deterministic sample
print('target_sample_ids', sorted(liked_and_in_libraries_ids)[:20])

# Re-verify SMS delivery by fetching the sent text message
sent_id = sms_resp.get('text_message_id') if 'sms_resp' in globals() and sms_resp else None
print('sent_text_message_id', sent_id)

sms_check = apis.phone.show_text_message(text_message_id=sent_id, access_token=phone_token)
print('sms_check', sms_check)

# Check playlist criteria using cached playlist_details
is_public_ok = bool(playlist_details.get('is_public'))
playlist_song_count = len(playlist_details.get('songs', []))
print('playlist_is_public_ok', is_public_ok, 'playlist_song_count', playlist_song_count, 'expected', len(song_ids_to_add))

# Success criteria
criteria_ok = is_public_ok and (playlist_song_count == len(song_ids_to_add)) and (sms_check.get('text_message_id') == sent_id)
print('criteria_ok', criteria_ok)

# Complete task
if criteria_ok:
    apis.supervisor.complete_task()
